Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one premium character cutout for a curated art-inspiration collection in a character editor. Deliver exactly ONE standalone character, not a sheet, not multiple poses, not a collage. Square canvas; entire character and all accessories fully visible, centered, occupying approximately 70% of the square, generous even transparent padding, no edge crops. Truly transparent alpha background, no white or colored rectangle, no checkerboard rendered into the picture, no environment or UI. Consistent orthographic product-photography look with barely perceptible perspective, large soft side-and-top key light and gentle fill, neutral white balance, delicate grounded contact shadow only. Subtle physical asymmetry, tactile handmade life, exquisite close-range material rendering, restrained design. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no decorative halo, no platform or pedestal.
Primary request: completely reimagine Dot as a small rounded slightly flattened COBALT BLUE ball with exceptionally refined dense SHORT plush fibers, softly groomed and lying naturally on its body, a velvety softly feathered edge. The silhouette is a single simple softly compressed orb, no lobes, no limbs, no hands, no feet. Two small dark vertically oriented capsule eyes sit cleanly embedded on its front, understated and calm, no mouth. It wears snug dark charcoal over-ear headphones with small softly padded earcups contacting and subtly compressing the plush at both sides, delicate contact shadows. A slim soft padded headband closely follows the upper curvature of the ball with almost no air gap, complete unobstructed headband visible. Avoid a giant floating headband, no hat, no beret. Rich luminous royal cobalt blue, not pale cyan. Natural ordered microfibers, never granular noise, hard spikes, coarse shag or bristles. Nearly frontal with a tiny natural tilt. A quiet charming tactile designer collectible.

Primary request: reimagine Grok as a restrained small round-arched soft blob collectible, off-white with the faintest cool mint hint, matte soft silicone with subtle smooth tactile microtexture. Broad rounded plump dome, very slightly asymmetrical soft base, not an inflated cushion or pillow, no ghost frills. Classic two thin elongated dark vertical capsule eyes. Mild three-quarter angle. It wears very small delicate dark graphite rounded eyeglasses fitting close to the face; simple thin frame, the eyes remain clear. One small silver laptop placed diagonally LOW in front, open with the SCREEN FACING THE CHARACTER, exterior lid facing viewer, wholly below eye level so it never hides the face. Absolutely plain unbranded silver lid and tiny restrained keyboard detail, no words, no icons, no logo. Blob is quietly looking down slightly at its own screen, with an attentive natural demeanor. Tiny unobtrusive rounded hand pads may rest naturally by the low keyboard only if anatomically coherent. Emphasize radical simplicity, harmonious proportions, soft authentic contact between glasses and body, restrained highlights, no glossy plastic or wax, not a humanoid robot.

Primary request: an ORIGINAL warm humanlike fabric doll called Muse, handcrafted stop-motion collectible, seated in a compact natural pose, full head, complete body and all accessories visible. Warm medium-brown face made of fine woven linen/cotton with visible tiny weave; little rounded fabric nose, small deeply black embedded glass eyes with a single subtle catchlight, eyes turned gently DOWN toward an open tiny book it holds naturally in both fabric hands. Deep dark brown short curly wool hair with soft loose fiber wisps; curls have tactile strand structure, not molded plastic. Mustard-yellow woven cloth top, blue-and-white knitted scarf with clearly legible yarn loops and soft drape, and subdued dark cloth lower body with two little seated legs/feet fully visible. The small open book has warm cream paper and a plain cover, no visible text. Upper body and expressive reading gesture are the emphasis while the full small seated doll remains within frame. Clearly distinct materials: fine brown fabric face, woolly curls, woven garment, coarse soft knitted scarf, glass eyes and paper book. Subtle stitched mouth, calm thoughtful reading expression. No peach plastic skin, no waxy face, no human photoreal skin, no resin hair, no imitation of any named existing Muse/Veda character. Only this one original character and its worn scarf and book.
